user_query: trass gmail with the word mgm last 30 days

intent.goal: find emails in trass gmail containing 'mgm'

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
u.page_id,
u.workspace,
u.database_name,
u.title,
u.created_time,
g.subject,
g.sender_name,
g.sender_email,
g.body_snippet,
g.message_content
FROM unified_content u
JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE (
    u.database_name = 'gmail'
    AND u.workspace IN ('trass')
    AND (
        g.subject LIKE '%mgm%'
        OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%mgm%'
        OR g.message_content LIKE '%mgm%'
        OR g.sender_name LIKE '%mgm%'
        OR g.sender_email LIKE '%mgm%'
    )
    AND u.created_time >= datetime('now', '-30 days')
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1200
